description: List the saved versions of a share: version number, when it was written, and how big it was. Use when the user asks 'what versions are there', 'show the history', 'can I get back the previous version', 'what did this look like before'. Editing a share keeps the old content rather than overwriting it.  Requires an edit token (auto-loaded from local storage) or a saved sync code.
name: qhs_versions
